CHOKH_LICENSE_KEY.about: The licence key that turns on the paid features it names. Checked on the server; nothing is sent anywhere to check it

CHOKH_PUBLIC_URL.about: Where the dashboard is reached from outside, so an alert can link to it and single sign-on can name its return address

CHOKH_SMTP_URL.about: `smtp://user:pass@host:587` or `smtps://...`. With `CHOKH_MAIL_FROM`, turns on email for alerts and digests

CHOKH_BREVO_API_KEY.about: Email over Brevo's API instead of SMTP, for a host whose mail ports are closed. With `CHOKH_MAIL_FROM`, turns on email; used when both are set

CHOKH_MAIL_FROM.about: The address alert and digest email comes from

CHOKH_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.about: A Telegram bot's token. Turns on Telegram for alerts; the chat is set on each alert

CHOKH_OIDC_ISSUER.about: Single sign-on: the provider's issuer, copied exactly as its discovery document states it

CHOKH_OIDC_CLIENT_ID.about: Single sign-on: the client id the provider gave this install

CHOKH_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.about: Single sign-on: the client secret the provider gave this install
